meta.notes: Elden Ring + Shadow of the Erdtree crafting data scraped from Fextralife wiki pages (Oct 2026). Item categories and material types are editorial groupings. DLC entries are prefixed '(Shadow of the Erdtree)' in whereToFind. Upgrade materials (Smithing/Somber stones, Grave/Ghost Gloveworts, Golden Seed, Sacred Tear, Scadutree Fragment, Revered Spirit Ash) are included in materials. The 6 Crafting Kit default recipes were cross-checked against Eldenpedia. See NOTES.md for caveats.

categories.name: Arrows & Bolts
categories.description: Craftable arrows, greatarrows, bolts and greatbolts (most recipes yield a stack per craft).

categories.name: Pots
categories.description: Throwable pots and roped pots; most require a Cracked Pot (or Ritual Pot), which is returned to inventory after the pot is used.

categories.name: Hefty Pots (Shadow of the Erdtree)
categories.description: Larger DLC pots crafted with a Hefty Cracked Pot; the Hefty Cracked Pot is returned after use.

categories.name: Greases
categories.description: Weapon buffs applied with a grease; drawstring variants buff bows.

categories.name: Buff Foods
categories.description: Livers, cured meats, raisins, fowl feet, turtle necks and other consumable buffs.

categories.name: Throwables & Utility
categories.description: Darts, stones, branches, glintstones, harpoons, soap and other utility items.

The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients.

Those who would otherwise be at each other's throats are united in service to Miquella—as long as the charm that binds them remains intact.

items.description: page for enemies effected by this grease. Solidified knotgrease made from a sharp gravel-stone mixture. Craftable item. Coats armament, granting a potent anti-dragon effect. The effect lasts only for a short time. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants.

items.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Recipe: Igon's Cookbook [1] — Can be found on a corpse in the broken tower just before the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Communion Harpoon
items.description: Harpoon bristling with sharp gravel stones. Craftable item. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy damage. Has an anti-dragon effect. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants. Where to find Dragon Communion Harpoon in Elden Ring Grand Altar of Dragon Communion : On the giant dragon corpse's wing.

items.name: Dragon Communion Flesh
items.description: A lump of animal flesh with a heat that never cools. Craftable item. Boosts vigor, stamina, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. An imitation of dragonscale flesh created by human hands, used to sate the hunger of drake warriors—if only briefly. Where to find Dragon Communion Flesh in Elden Ring Igon's Cookbook [2] can be found at the edge of a cliff near the Jagged Peak Mountainside site of grace.

items.name: Glinting Nail
items.description: uses FP to fire a shattering magic nail at an enemy. Nailstone with shining fingerprints floating above. Craftable item. Uses FP to fling a magic nail that crumbles during flight. The lampreys that guard the finger ruins resemble fingers far more than they do humans, and so the finger-weavers imitated their sorcery. Where to find Glinting Nail in Elden Ring Cathedral of Manus Metyr : Leave the main room from the opening on the side.

The delightful festival is an old tradition; one old enough for the Erdtree to tacitly tolerate its endurance. Where to find Festive Grease in Elden Ring Shadow Keep : Past the Ghost Npc, take the stairs up and find in near the edge, besides a couple of Messmer Soldiers.

items.name: Golden Vow

The incantation serves as a rite that honors the comrades who placed their faith in the distant Erdtree and gave their lives in the crusade. Where to find Golden Vow (Item) in Elden Ring Shadow Keep : x3 Can be found in the area with the big golden tree, it is guarded by a Black Knight.
items.effect: Uses FP to increase attack and defense
items.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Recipe: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3] — The item can be looted from a corpse, located inside an army tent.

items.name: Sunwarmth Stone

Where to find Sunwarmth Stone in Elden Ring Enir-Ilim : From the Scadutree Fragment, head outside and take the path on the left, you'll find this item at the edge. Be wary of an enemy roaming the area.

items.name: Uplifting Aromatic
items.description: Art of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to raise the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half. This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.
items.effect: Boosts ally and self attack power and reduces incoming damage once.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Perfumer's Cookbook [1] — In the first chest when entering Perfumer's Ruins, NW of Abandoned Coffin site in Altus Plateau. Near the table where the Perfume Bottle is located.

items.name: Poison Spraymist
items.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to release a poison mist from user's mouth, causing a buildup of poison. Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.
items.effect: Uses FP to release poison mist from the mouth.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Perfumer's Cookbook [2] — Found on a corpse sitting in a chair on one of the rooftops at The Shaded Castle, in Altus Plateau. From the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace, head north and climb up the ladder on your left. Enter the dark library area and look for a ladder up, climb up to find the Cookbook.

items.name: Bloodboil Aromatic
items.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor, raising maximum attack power and stamina while also increasing damage received. "Even upon the battlefield, do you fear being wounded? Take a good look. Your limbs are frozen stiff."
items.effect: Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Perfumer's Cookbook [2] — Found on a corpse sitting in a chair on one of the rooftops at The Shaded Castle, in Altus Plateau. From the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace, head north and climb up the ladder on your left. Enter the dark library area and look for a ladder up, climb up to find the Cookbook.

items.name: Ironjar Aromatic
items.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to temporarily turn body to steel, boosting poise, resistances and damage negation at the expense of mobility and vulnerability to lightning. An art that requires fragments of hunted noble jars. Depraved perfumers are plainly in league with jar poachers.
items.effect: Uses FP to temporarily turn wielder's body to steel
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Perfumer's Cookbook [3] — Auriza Side Tomb, open the transporter chest in the room with many benches. The room you'll be teleported to will have a corpse with Perfumer's Cookbook [3] on it.

items.name: Acid Spraymist
items.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to release an acidic mist from user's mouth, damaging armaments and temporarily lowering attack power. Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.
items.effect: Uses FP to release acid mist from the mouth
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Perfumer's Cookbook [4] — Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Ainsel River for 3000 Runes.

items.name: Sleep Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw enemies to cause buildup of sleep. Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, its light-purple haze irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw to cause buildup of Sleep
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [1] — Found on a corpse in the graveyard in a plateau south from Summonwater Village Outskirts.

items.name: Soporific Grease
items.description: coats an armament, inflicting sleep. Solidified grease made from a mixture of light-purple materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, inflicting sleep. The effect lasts only for a short time.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting sleep
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [2] — Raya Lucaria Academy Sold by the Isolated Merchant south-east of the Main Academy Gate for 3500 Runes.

items.name: Drawstring Soporific Grease
items.description: quickly coats an armament, inflicting sleep. Solidified grease made from a mixture of light-purple materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting sleep, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting sleep
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [2] — Raya Lucaria Academy Sold by the Isolated Merchant south-east of the Main Academy Gate for 3500 Runes.

items.name: Sleepbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with sleep. Craftable item. Craft yield: 10.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [2] — Raya Lucaria Academy Sold by the Isolated Merchant south-east of the Main Academy Gate for 3500 Runes.

items.name: Sleepbone Arrow (Fletched)
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with sleep. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight. Craft yield: 10.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [2] — Raya Lucaria Academy Sold by the Isolated Merchant south-east of the Main Academy Gate for 3500 Runes.

items.name: Sleepbone Bolt
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [2] — Raya Lucaria Academy Sold by the Isolated Merchant south-east of the Main Academy Gate for 3500 Runes.

items.name: Bewitching Branch
items.description: , and can be crafted with rare items. Tree branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item. Pierce a foe, using FP to turn them into a temporary ally. The Empyrean Miquella is loved by many people. Indeed, he has learned very well how to compel such affection.
items.effect: Uses FP to charm pierced enemy
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Fevor's Cookbook [3] — Reward from Gideon Ofnir after visiting Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum

items.name: Clarifying Boluses
items.description: Yellow boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates madness buildup. Madness accumulates slowly, inflicting heavy damage and reducing FP once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such events.
items.effect: Alleviates madness buildup
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Frenzied's Cookbook [1] — Liurnia of the Lakes Found on a body in one of the houses of the Frenzied Flame Village

items.name: Frenzyflame Stone
items.description: Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Three Fingers. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate warmth, continuously restoring the HP of those who host the frenzied flame. Confers madness upon those who have not adopted the flame. Take care not to mistake this for its gentler cousin.
items.effect: Uses FP to continuously heal chaos followers
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Frenzied's Cookbook [2] — Found nearest to the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. Behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room is a hidden path which can be opened by attacking the altar behind the chest after the boss fight.

items.name: Fire Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict fire damage.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict Fire Damage
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

items.name: Roped Fire Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to inflict fire damage.
items.effect: Throw behind to inflict Fire Damage.
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

items.name: Bone Dart
items.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing. Craftable item. Throw at enemies to inflict damage.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

items.name: Rowa Raisin
items.description: Preparation of dried Rowa fruit. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent, the spectral steed, while riding to restore his HP. Humans are unable to digest Rowa fruit, but Torrent seems to have a taste for it.
items.effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to restore HP
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

items.name: Rainbow Stone
items.description: which can be used for marking a place for other players for a short time. Ruin Fragment that has undergone some simple processing. Craftable item. Stones such as these shine with the colors of the rainbow, making them useful markers when placed on the ground. Can also be dropped to gauge the distance of a fall. The higher the pitch of the sound, the higher the likelihood of the fall being fatal. Once used to entertain children on the fringes of the Lands Between.
items.effect: Shines with colored light when placed, serving as a guide
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Craftable item. Reveals cooperative and competitive multiplayer signs. Co-op summoning signs will be shown in gold, while hostile summoning signs will be shown in red. Multiplayer begins when you summon a player from another world through their sign.
items.effect: Reveals co-op and hostile summoning signs
items.whereToFind: Recipe: Crafting Kit (default recipes) — Recipes come with the Crafting Kit, purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh, Limgrave, for 300 runes (or from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold if two Shardbearers are defeated first).

materials.name: Beast Horn
materials.description: Horn suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts of the realm of shadow. The Crucible has a particularly strong influence on the beasts of the realm of shadow, causing many to grow horns despite the characteristics of their species.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Dropped by horned beasts by the Viaduct Minor Tower Dropped by Shadowpots in Shadow Keep Dropped by Shadow Commoners | Found: Shadow Keep: x4 Take the stairs up to reach the middle area of the library. In the center vestibule, the item is behind a Fire Knight. Shadow Keep: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the west and you will find a Fire Knight, and behind it you will find the item. Shadow Keep: x4 Near the rails of the area, there is a shadow enemy next to the item, and a Fire Knight patrolling the area.

materials.name: Spirit Calculus
materials.description: An exceedingly rare to find calculus, suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts in the ancient ruins of Rauh. Has a distinctive acrid odor, which some claim to be a sign of particular spiritual potency.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Dropped by Shadowpots in Shadow Keep Dropped by horned beasts by the Viaduct Minor Tower | Found: Shadow Keep: At the side of a Fire Knight on the sixth floor, below the Seventh Floor site of grace. Found on a body on a broken column, in Ancient Ruins of Rauh. To the left side of the first site of grace of the area.

materials.name: Pearlescent Scale
materials.description: A glassy and glistening fragment of pearlescent hue. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting lamprey. These retrograde scales are found embedded deep within the skin of lamprey.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Killing Lampreys in the following places: Finger Ruins of Rhia Finger Ruins of Dheo Finger Ruins of Miyr | Found: Drop by hunting lamprey (Black snake/fingerworms found in the finger ruins)

materials.name: Scorpion Liver
materials.description: Fresh organ of a spider-scorpion. It is referred to as liver,but no one is quite sure of its purpose. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting spider-scorpions. A delicacy known for its numbing toxins.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Belurat Tower Settlement dungeon entrance from Spider Scorpions | Found: Ancient Ruins of Rauh: x3. In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this. [ Video Location ]

materials.name: Fly Mold
materials.description: A species of fungus known for its deathly sweet stench. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting man-flies. Cultivated using the flesh and blood of man-flies, it can serve as pot innards.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Moldmonger's Bell Bearing unlocks Fly Mold at Twin Maiden Husks Dropped by Man-Flies in various places | Found: 4x of this material can looted from a corpse by the cliff, guarded by several man-fly enemies. x2 Fly Mold can be found on a corpse northwest of the Abandoned Ailing Village.

materials.name: Rada Fruit
materials.description: Berry-like fruit that grows into spiritgrave grass. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow, though its bitter taste makes it unsuitable for consumption by humans.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be purchased from Moore Dropped from Shadow Commoners Herbalist's Bell Bearing unlocks Rada Fruit at Twin Maiden Husks wares | Found: Climb the crumbled structure of the building north of Temple Town Ruins. Belurat Tower Settlement: x3 can be found on a corpse in the northeast corner of the room. Shadow Keep: x4 From the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace. Take the eastern exit and turn right rounding the building, you will come across an opening, enter to find the item. x4 On a body, in the area where you fight the second Urcerated Tree Spirit.

materials.name: Redflesh Mushroom
materials.description: Red mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be purchased from Moore Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing (1) unlocks Redflesh Mushroom at Twin Maiden Husks wares Dropped by Shadow Commoners | Found: Belurat Tower Settlement: x3 Take the stairs up the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and head up the crumbling rooftops. Take the small walkway, defeat the two shadow enemies, and then there are two more. But the final two are giant shadow enemies. Defeat them and you'll find a Redflesh Mushroom x3 near the drainage.

materials.name: Whiteflesh Mushroom
materials.description: Milky-white mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be purchased from Moore Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing (2) unlocks Whiteflesh Mushroom at Twin Maiden Husks wares Dropped by Shadow Commoners | Found: x3 Whiteflesh Mushroom can be found on a corpse. Be wary as it is being protected by three dogs. Enir-Ilim: The area looks like outdoor with a large tree in of the area. On one of the long dead corpses, the item will be there. Belurat Tower Settlement: From the Serpent Arrow, head across to an area with a ladder.

materials.name: Knot Resin
materials.description: Knot-shaped lump of resin that exuded from the roots of trees. Material used for crafting items. Found near tree roots everywhere in the realm of shadow. Serves as a primitive catalyst, making it suitable for processing using sorceries, incantations, and the like.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Moore's Bell Bearing and Greasemonger's Bell Bearing unlocks Knot Resin at Twin Maiden Husks wares Can be purchased from Moore Dropped from Shadow Commoners at the Moorth Ruins | Found: Fog Rift Catacombs: Once you reach the room with the spikes that falls from the ceiling. Wait until it drops and jump on it. Move to the upper platform to find this item on a dead body. Belurat Tower Settlement: x5 Can be found guarded by 4 Man-Flies on a small island in the Well depths swamp. Belurat Tower Settlement: can be found on a corpse near the waterfall. Fort of Reprimand: x4. In the lower area, where you fight the Omenkiller.

materials.name: Dewgem
materials.description: Succulent plant that has supped on night-tinged dew. Material used for crafting items. Glows at night and blossoms mainly at the waterside. Said to have been used in the practice of sprite medicine long ago.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed by the Church of Consolation, Ellac River, and other rivers or lakes | Found: Turn left before entering the Church of Consolation to find one. Fort of Reprimand: From the Broken Rune, take the stairs up, and loot the body hanging at the top. Castle Ensis: x3 Dewgem can be pillaged from a corpse. The body can be found sitting by the edge of a cliff. Belurat Tower Settlement: x3 can be found on a corpse in the Ulcerated Tree Spirit arena.

materials.name: Black Pyrefly
materials.description: Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings. Material used for crafting items. Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame. They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be purchased from Moore Moore's Bell Bearing unlocks Black Pyrefly in Twin Maidens Husks wares Can be farmed at the following locations: Belurat Tower Settlement dungeon entrance Scorched Ruins | Found: Belurat Tower Settlement: Can be pillaged from a corpse on the left side of the stairs. x3 Can be found on a corpse past the bridge from which you will be attacked. You will face 3 enemies there. x2 Take the stairs up past the Site of Grace, and turn right. Beware of the Horned Warrior. Continue moving to find several shadow enemies, and climb up the crumbling structure to reach the decayed rooftop.

materials.name: Glintslab Firefly
materials.description: Glintstone firefly improved by selective breeding. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near Manus Metyr. The glintstone that produces its light has become freakishly enlarged, while the span of its life is as brief as a whisper.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Rabbath's Rise | Found: Shadow Keep: Past the Storehouse site of grace, continue forward you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies. The item is to the left before the enemies. x3 Ccan be looted from a bod. x2 Can be looted off a corpse. The body is found lying by the edge of a cliff.

materials.name: Yellow Fulgurbloom
materials.description: Yellow flower that crackles with lightning. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the realm of shadow's underground gravesites and places struck by lightning. Imbued with yellow lightning's essence.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: North of Cerulean Coast, at the water past the river and the Furnace Golem. Dropped by Lightning Sheep | Found: Fog Rift Catacombs: In the room with the 2 Messmer Soldiers, turn back and find it, besides the entrance. Fog Rift Catacombs: In the room with the sorcerer at the bridge, past it, on the left. Beware the goblin on the right. Fog Rift Catacombs: Once you reach the room with the spikes that falls from the ceiling. Wait until it drops and jump on it. Move to the upper platform to find this item on the right side.

materials.name: Shadow Sunflower
materials.description: A large flower that blooms facing the Scadutree. Material used for crafting items. Found near the Scadutree. These flowers, veiled in shadow and covered in impenetrable thorns, are suffused with profound holiness—much akin to the Scadutree itself.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Spawn at Hinterland Bridge site of Grace and head north. Following the cliffside you will find roughly 10 of them. Head to the Scadutree Base after killing the Scadutree Avatar to find 3 to 4 | Found: Shadow Keep: From the Storehouse site of grace, find the ladder and climb it up, pass the enemies. Circle the area on your right and you will find an opening that leads outside, take it and you will find the item on a corpse on the left side near the edge. Shadow Keep: From the Well-Pickled Turtle Neck, move forward, turn left, and keep advancing until you find the entrance of a big church-like building.

materials.name: Toxic Mossling
materials.description: A large moss animal glutted with poison. Material used for crafting items. Found in poison swamps. Round and plump, like a darling infant.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be purchased from Thiollier | Found: Can be found in the Realm of Shadows' swamps. Can be purchased from Thiollier for 2000 Runes.

materials.name: Scarlet Bud
materials.description: A large, rotten bud that will never come into bloom. Material used for crafting items. Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot. There was a time when these buds were not touched by the scarlet rot's blight—when they were the symbol of the small church deep in the ancient ruins of Rauh.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: You can farm Scarlet Bud in the rot cave behind the Church of the Bud Main Entrance. | Found: Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot

materials.name: Sanguine Amaryllis
materials.description: A bloodflower with meaty petals. Material used for crafting items. Grown by bloodfiends in pools of blood. Perhaps even the fiends admire blood's beauty.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Moore's Bell Bearing unlocks Sanguine Amaryllis in Twin Maiden Husks wares Can be purchased from Moore Plenty can be found in the large room filled with numerous bloodfiends prior to the Rivermouth Cave boss room. | Found: Found east to the Prospect Town, on the lower level. West side of the Prospect Town. On the pond west of Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace. Protected by various Bloodfiends and dogs.

materials.name: Frozen Maggot
materials.description: Frozen maggots that somehow continue to wriggle. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in gaols. The maggots develop in great-jar innards, and are an invaluable source of sustenance to the prisoners.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Belurat Gaol Bonny Gaol | Found: Bonny Gaol: From the Site of grace, take the path down, and after the first enemy, turn right and you'll find a room. There are two enemies there. Defeat the enemies and loot the corpse on the left side corner of the room.

materials.name: Deep-Purple Lily
materials.description: A deep-purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Grows in the blue flower field at the coast. Like a syrupy poison, its nectar lulls the imbiber into sweet, velvety sleep.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Cerulean Coast | Found: Mainly grows in the blue flower fields at the Cerulean Coast. One can also be found within a cave near the Ellac River Cave Site of Grace. 3x found on a corpse on the way down to The Fissure Site of Grace to the southeast of the Cerulean Coast. Stone Coffin Fissure: From the Stone Coffin Fissure Site of Grace, continue following the path and descend carefully.

materials.name: Nectarblood Burgeon
materials.description: A young shoot, heavy with velvety purple nectar. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Said to burgeon forth where the nectar-like blood of abandoned Trina pooled.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Very rare drop from the bloodfiends near the Fissure Cross site of grace. Several can be found in the Stone Coffin Fissure Small chance to drop from the sleeping critters directly next to the Fissure Depths Site of Grace. | Found: Stone Coffin Fissure: When you reach the bottom, face east and head to the lower level. Beware of the slimes that will fall from the ceiling. To the left, you can pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina tucked at the end of this short cave. Go to the other path where a Gravebird is resting on the edge. Do a sneak attack and then pick up the Nectarblood Burgeon from where it was sitting.

materials.name: Winter-Lantern Fly
materials.description: Winged insect carrying a dangling frenzied flame grape. Material used for crafting items. Flies lazily around the abyssal forest. Said to be heralds of the aging untouchable. On seeing these, the wise know to stay well clear of that place.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Abyssal Woods Midra's Manse | Found: Found in Abyssal Woods. Dropped by enemies in Midra's Manse.

materials.name: Swollen Grape
materials.description: An eyeball of the frenzied flame that has swollen from within. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Marked with fingerprint burns, proof of having being touched directly by the Three Fingersembrace.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Dropped by the rats in Midra's Manse | Found: Drop by grape-head enemies in Abyssal Woods. Can also be found in Midra's Manse. Very rare drop from enemies in Midra's Manse.

materials.name: Grave Keeper's Brainpan
materials.description: Skull bone of an old grave keeper. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo. The old grave keepers are boatsmen, and continue to summon the dead even after withering away.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed at Charo's Hidden Grave partially buried | Found: Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo.

materials.name: Horn-Strewn Excrement
materials.description: Excrement of a large carnivorous beast containing fragments of horns. Material used for crafting items. Found underfoot in places like forests where beasts dwell. It is said that the deadliest of the horned predators enjoy the sport of hunting and devouring other horned creatures.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: From 'Ravine North' grace, head straight north to find a pile containing x1. From that pile, head straight west to another pile containing x2. After that, head west THEN south (to avoid bears) to find a pile containing x1. Lastly, head south-by-southwest for a massive pile containing x3. | Found: Found underfoot in places like forests where beast dwell.

materials.name: Gas Stone
materials.description: Block of stone infused with hot gas. Material used for crafting items. Found in the ruined forges. Perhaps these were once used as fuel for the smithing process.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Lava Ruined Forge | Found: Ruined Forge Lava Intake: Take the first ladder down, past the golem. After the fire blob, turn left and you will find a round with a golem sitting. In this room, you will find this item near the back wall. Ruined Forge Lava Intake: Take the first ladder down, and turn left and back, to reach a small area, in which you will find this alongside a few Smithing Stones.

materials.name: Ghostflame Bloom
materials.description: Ghostflame flower that grows in gravesites. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the hidden grave of Charo. Of a pair with another gravesite flower, the grave violet. All but incorporeal, it burns without so much as a sound.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Charo's Hidden Grave | Found: Found throughout the Hidden Grave of Charo area.

materials.name: Grave Cricket
materials.description: Cricket that produces a raspy cry. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near stone coffins. The sound of these crickets are often taken to be the rustling of the restless dead, or sometimes the sound of their calling voices.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Lake east of Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace | Found: Mainly found near stone coffins

materials.name: Dragon's Calorbloom
materials.description: Flower with an uncanny shape, coursing with hot blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A single flower is said to blossom—only once—from the hearts of dead warriors who oft partook of the Dragon Communion.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Travel to Jagged Peak Mountainside site of grace and descend the mountain the same way you came up. If you defeated Senessax, the arena is now populated by slimes (recommend you kill them since they have a chance to drop Sharp Gravel Stone, which is required for the crafting the same item that the C… | Found: Jagged Peak animals

materials.name: Finger Mimic
materials.description: Light-pink mushroom resembling a wizened finger. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Used to by those who wish to become fingers to induce hallucinations. They call these mushrooms the stillborn of the Two Fingers.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Farm: Can be farmed in the following locations: Finger Ruins of Rhia Finger Ruins of Dheo Finger Ruins of Miyr | Found: Finger Ruins of Rhia Rare drop from lamprey enemies.

materials.name: Empyrean-Blood Burgeon

materials.name: Bloodrose
materials.description: Blood-slick roses that bloom in festering blood. Material used for crafting items. Particularly beloved by those who serve the Lord of Blood. Glory to his inevitable reign.

materials.description: Can be found in many Catacombs. A purple flower that blooms in graveyards. Material used for crafting items. The hue of ghostflame, it's believed to be useful in calling forth spirits.

materials.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower

materials.name: Golden Sunflower
materials.description: A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees. At the foot of the Erdtree, they retain their color, along with a powerful holy essence.

materials.name: Trina's Lily
materials.description: A pale purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A symbol of faith in St. Trina. Dulls the senses, preventing agitation.

materials.name: Miquella's Lily
materials.description: A delicate water lily of unalloyed gold that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items. Exeedingly rare to find. A flower signifying faith in the Haligtree. Thought to be beloved by the Empyrean Miquella in his youth.

materials.description: A young plant, crystalized before it could mature. Material used for crafting items. Widely found in Liurnia Lake.

materials.description: An immature bud containing fresh blood. Material used for crafting items. Believed to originate long ago from a strain of buds cultivated with youthful, sacramental blood.

materials.name: Eye of Yelough
materials.description: A shrub fruit bursting with ripened pulp. Material used for crafting items. Grown in lands afflicted by frenzy, it's used for its pain-relieving properties... Though it's also known to be a dangerous intoxicant.
materials.whereToFind: Farm: Yelough Anix Ruins: Kill all the Frenzied Troll Knights. materials.name: Miranda Powder
materials.description: Pollen from a man-eating miranda flower. Material used for crafting items. Throughout history, perfumers have prized this extremely fragrant form of miranda pollen, not yet scattered into the air.

materials.name: Root Resin
materials.description: Resin secreted from the roots of the Greattree. Can also be found near trees on the surface. Material used in crafting items. The roots of the Greattree were once linked to those of the Erdtree, or so they say, and it is for this reason catacombs are built around Greattree roots.
materials.whereToFind: Farm: Warmaster's Shack: Ten feet northeast of the Site of Grace. | Found: Found near trees or the roots of the Greattree Infinitely spawns

materials.name: Cave Moss
materials.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves. Material used in crafting items. A fundamental ingredient for medicinal boluses.
materials.whereToFind: Farm: Coastal Cave: Several available in this cave. | Found: Found in dark caves Infinitely spawns

materials.name: Budding Cave Moss

materials.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, laced with fine crystals. Material used for crafting items. Among mosses, it possesses unique medicinal properties.
materials.whereToFind: Farm: Sellia Hideaway: One right next to the Site of Grace. | Found: Found in dark caves Infinitely spawns

materials.name: String
materials.description: Boasting no special qualities, this is merely a goodly length of string. Material used for crafting items. Often carried by demi-humans. Used to make certain items easier to use.

materials.name: Hefty Cracked Pot
materials.description: This hefty empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Essential vessel for crafting hefty cracked pot items. The materials and magics sealed within deploy their effects when the pot is thrown. The greater potentates of Bonny Village craft these and store them in a frozen gaol.
materials.whereToFind: In the World 1 in Scorched Ruins: From the location of the Ghost NPC, south of the Scorched Ruins. Head north and take the first right to the higher ground. Alongside a group of Shadows, you will find a body containing this item. 3 in Belurat Gaol: Inside a treasure chest in a room full of hanging pots that players have to jump down between. [ Video Link ] Another one can be found within a labyrinth full of large jars after falling down a broken staircase trap. [ Video Link ] A last one can be found on some jar pots nearby.

materials.name: Ritual Pot
materials.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot. Essential vessel for crafting ritual pot items. The materials and magics sealed within deploy their effects when the pot is thrown.
materials.whereToFind: Found: 1 in Laskyar Ruins: On a corpse in the northern section, in front of a set of pillars. ; 1 by the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace in Raya Lucaria Academy: Inside a treasure chest at the end of the hallway, guarded by a Glintstone Sorcerer and a Giant Living Jar. ; 2 in Jarburg: The first is found on the roof of a hut in the north, use the rocky ledge near Jar Bairn to get on top of the hut. materials.name: Perfume Bottle
materials.description: For the weapon class, see Perfume Bottles. Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds. Essential vessel for crafting perfume items. The art of perfuming was once jealously guarded in the capital, but after the perfumers were drafted into service during the Shattering, the art became widely practiced throughout the Lands Between.
materials.whereToFind: In the world 2 in Leyndell, Royal Capital. From East Capital Rampart Site of Grace, go through the west door, travel south along the rampart, and take the lift down. Enter the multi-story tower, climb up the ladder, then find the bottle in a chest hidden behind a table. From Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, go out the door southeast, turn left and follow the main road northeast, go through the big doors, then follow the lower path (not the stair that leads you to the lift) to a dead end, where a Leonine Misbegotten and stray dogs guard the bottle.

materials.name: Scadutree Fragment
materials.description: Scadutree Fragment is an Upgrade Material in Elden Ring, debuting in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Scadutree Fragments are optional consumables that can be used to simultaneously enhance offensive and defensive capabilities at any Sites of Grace, acting like a permanent boost to your damage dealt and damage negation in the Land of Shadow. With the calibration update 1.12.2 attack and damage negation curve scaling of the Scadutree Blessing have been revised.
materials.whereToFind: (Shadow of the Erdtree) There are 50 Scadutree Fragments in the Land of Shadow.
